newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.3010 against the U.S. dollar on Friday from Thursday's 8.3023 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market.
The yuan opened higher at an intra-day high of 8.3001 and rose to consolidate around 8.3010 for most of the session, hitting a low of 8.3020.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.3010, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan moved below the key 8.30 resistance level where selling capped its uptrend.

"Strong pro-yuan sentiment has weakened due to intervention from the central bank and speculative selling in the past few days," said one dealer. "The 8.30 level has become the main resistance again."
"The rise of the U.S. dollar in the world market supported its rise against the yuan indirectly," a second dealer said.
Traders expect the yuan to move in a narrow range between 8.30 and 8.3010 early next week.
The yuan closed down at 7.3450 from 7.3200 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0740 from 1.0748 against the Hong Kong dollar.
